title: NDF-core v1.0.0
description: NORMORDIS Document Format — NDF-core structure. Canonical JSON object subject to JCS (RFC 8785) canonicalisation and CAdES-B-LTA signing.

ndf_version.description: NDF specification version (SemVer 2.0.0). Normative value for this schema: '1.0.0'.

ndf_id.description: Permanent document identifier. UUID v4 (RFC 9562). Generated before canonicalisation, immutable after finalisation.

estado.description: Document state at time of finalisation. Always 'ativo' in the NDF-core — immutable, signed. Archival lifecycle transitions (substituido, em_conservacao, etc.) are managed by the custodian system outside the NDF-core. See SPEC.md §2.4.

payload_hash_alg.description: Hash algorithm used to compute payload_hash. NDF 1.0.0 supports 'sha256' (NIST FIPS 180-4) exclusively. Introducing further algorithms requires a future version of this specification.

nivel_assinatura.description: Electronic-signature level that the producing system determined to be applicable to this document, under the legal regime and internal policy governing it. It is a declaration by the producer, not a determination by the format: NDF does not define which acts require which level. It conditions the finalisation pipeline and the certificate the envelope must carry. See SPEC.md §2.10 and §2.10.2.

ndt_version_ref.description: NDT version reference. Format: '<schema_id>@<versao_ndt>'. Must be resolvable in the .ndfpkg or a compliant registry.

metadados.description: Descriptive metadata, custody, GDPR block, and document type reference. See SPEC.md §2.7.

documento.description: Document logical content. Structure is opaque at NDF-core level; validated by the schema referenced in metadados.tipo_documento_ref.

avaliacao.description: Archival appraisal: retention period and final disposition, under the declared profile. See SPEC.md §3.

relacoes.description: Verifiable relations to other NDF documents (e.g. a parecer over an informação, a despacho deciding on a parecer). Optional. Part of the NDF-core — canonicalised and signed. See SPEC.md §2.11.

participantes.description: Structural index of individuals, entities or systems involved in producing this document, distinct from the electronic signatures in the envelope. Optional. See SPEC.md §2.12.

proveniencia_ia.description: Evidence of AI system involvement in producing or reviewing this document. Optional — only meaningful when AI materially influenced the content. See SPEC.md §2.13.

proveniencia_sistema.description: Deterministic system(s) that produced this document's content. Array, ordered chronologically by 'gerado_em', to support production chains (calculation engine → validation → issuance). Optional. Any non-deterministic component belongs in proveniencia_ia, never here. See SPEC.md §2.14.

imputacao.description: Legal responsibility for the document and the title under which it is held — distinct from who materially produced it. More than one entry means a joint act by two or more bodies, never a delegation chain. Optional. See SPEC.md §2.15.

tipo_documento_ref.description: Versioned reference to the document type schema. Canonical form '<id>@<versao>' for cross-organisational document forms held in specs/registry/, or qualified extension 'ext.<entidade>.<tipo>@<versao>' for domain-specific types defined and maintained by a producing entity. An extension type's schema MUST travel inside the .ndfpkg under schemas/. See SPEC.md §2.9.2 and ADR-014.

designacao.description: Official name of the producing entity.

sistema.description: Identifier scheme, as a qualified opaque identifier. Convention: '<jurisdicao>-<esquema>'.

valor.description: Identifier value, in the form used by the scheme. Syntax is the scheme's responsibility, not this schema's.

identificadores.description: Institutional identifiers of the producing entity, each qualified by its scheme. Optional. See SPEC.md §2.7.3 and ADR-017.

entidade_responsavel.description: Entity responsible for custody of the record. Always required, and distinct from the GDPR data controller (protecao_dados.responsavel_tratamento). See SPEC.md §2.7.2 and ADR-016.

assunto.description: Document title or brief description — indexable.

idioma.description: Primary language of the document, in the language[-script][-region] subset of BCP 47 (RFC 5646). Not the full BCP 47 grammar: extlang, variants, extensions, private-use and grandfathered tags are not admitted. Defaults to 'pt' when absent. See SPEC.md §2.7.2.

idiomas_autenticos.description: Languages in which this document's text is equally authentic, in the same BCP 47 subset as 'idioma'. Optional, and only for documents whose versions have the same legal force — EU legislation, treaties, acts of plurilingual States. MUST include the value of 'idioma', which in that case identifies no more than the version this NDF presents first. A translation that is NOT equally authentic is a different document, related by relacoes[] — declaring it here would assert an authenticity the producer does not have. Absence means the question does not arise, not that the document is monolingual in law. See SPEC.md §2.7.7.

perfil.description: Security classification regime whose legal labels map onto 'nivel'. Open enum; the meaning of a regime comes from the registry, not from this pattern.

nivel.description: Neutral ordinal sensitivity level, from least to most restricted. A reader that does not know the regime can still order two documents by sensitivity. See SPEC.md §2.7.4.

classificacao_seguranca.description: Information security classification. Descriptive signal for the custodian system, never an access control mechanism (§1.5). Optional; absence means NOT DECLARED, not a default level — a regime cannot be inferred from silence. See SPEC.md §2.7.4, §2.7.4.2 and ADR-017.

contem_dados_pessoais.description: True if the document contains personal data as defined by GDPR.

categorias.description: Categories of personal data. Open enum: 'identificacao_fiscal', 'rendimentos', 'saude', 'dados_processuais', 'biometricos', 'outros'.

regime.description: Data-protection regime whose vocabulary 'base' belongs to. Open enum; the meaning of a regime comes from the registry, not from this pattern.

base.description: Identifier of the legal basis within the declared regime, in that regime's own vocabulary (e.g. 'art6-1-c' under eu-gdpr). Deliberately not an enum: NDF does not enumerate the lawful bases of any regime, and an enum would be both jurisdiction-bound and incomplete.

fundamento_ref.description: Optional reference to the instrument or internal act that grounds the declared basis. Opaque to NDF, resolved by the producing system.

base_legal_conservacao.description: Legal basis for retaining the personal data, as determined and declared by the producer. A {regime, base} pair, on the same pattern as classificacao_seguranca: the regime supplies the vocabulary, and NDF assesses neither the vocabulary nor whether the declared basis is the correct one. See SPEC.md §1.4, ADR-017 and ADR-022.

responsavel_tratamento.description: Name of the data controller (GDPR Art. 13-14). Distinct from metadados.entidade_responsavel, which identifies custody of the record.

protecao_dados.description: GDPR block. Required if and only if contem_dados_pessoais is true. See SPEC.md §1.4, §2.7.2 and ADR-016.

origem_nao_identificavel.description: Declares that the origin of the content cannot be established. Fourth mode of the origin invariant (SPEC.md §2.2.1). Must not coexist with a declaration that identifies the origin.

fundamento.description: Reason why the origin cannot be established. Mandatory: without it the field would be an escape hatch from the invariant.
examples: Documento em papel digitalizado, sem menção de autor nem de serviço emissor.
Denúncia anónima recebida por via postal.

perfil.description: Archival appraisal profile in force. Determines the vocabulary and syntax of classificacao_ref and instrumento_ref. Opaque qualified identifier of two or more segments: meaning comes from the registry, not from the pattern. Open enum; a registered profile's schema lives in specs/registry/profiles/<perfil>.schema.json and MUST travel inside the .ndfpkg under schemas/. See SPEC.md §3.2.3 and ADR-015.

classificacao_ref.description: Reference to the archival class/series within the instrument identified by instrumento_ref. Syntax is profile-dependent. See SPEC.md §3.2.1.

forma_contagem.description: Retention period counting start (trigger). See SPEC.md §3.3.

forma_contagem_detalhe.description: Required when forma_contagem is 'outro'. Free-text description.

destino_final.description: Final disposition once the retention period elapses. 'a_determinar' declares that the decision is not the producer's to take and is pending appraisal by the authority named in autoridade_avaliacao. See SPEC.md §3.4.

autoridade_avaliacao.description: Authority competent to decide the final disposition. Required if and only if destino_final is 'a_determinar'. See SPEC.md §3.4.1.

instrumento_ref.description: Instrument and version used to resolve the retention period and final disposition at finalisation time. Syntax is profile-dependent. See SPEC.md §3.2.2.

tipo.description: Base relation vocabulary (closed enum) or a qualified extension in the form 'ext.<entidade>.<tipo>' (e.g. 'ext.at.retificacao-oficiosa'), for domain-specific relation types not covered by the base vocabulary. Extending the base vocabulary itself still requires a new minor specification version. See SPEC.md §2.11.2 and §2.11.7.

payload_hash.description: payload_hash of the target document at the exact canonical content the relation was established over. Format '<alg>:<hex>' — algorithm-agnostic. Ensures the relation binds to specific immutable bytes, not merely to a logical identity.

descricao.description: Human-readable description of the target document, for readability.

papel.description: Free-text, short, informative role of the target within this relation (e.g. 'informacao_base'). Not a second closed classification axis — 'tipo' already carries the normative semantics.

participante_ref.description: Stable institutional identifier of the natural person. Not a display name — display data belongs to the tipo_documento_ref schema and/or the NDT.

papel.description: Role exercised by this natural person in producing this document. Independent of any electronic signature — a participant may be an author without signing, and a signatory may sign without being an author. Systems belong in proveniencia_sistema, AI in proveniencia_ia, and legal responsibility in imputacao.

tipo.description: Professional capacity, when it is a condition of the document's validity. Open enum: 'contabilista_certificado', 'revisor_oficial_contas', 'advogado', 'engenheiro', 'arquiteto', 'medico'.

identificador.description: Professional body membership identifier. External reference, not resolved by the NDF.

qualificacao.description: Optional. Professional capacity of this person, when legally required for the document to be valid. See SPEC.md §2.12.6.

referencia_externa.description: Reference to an artefact kept outside the NDF, under its own access and retention policy. Not resolved by the NDF — same principle as participante_ref (§2.12.4) and classificacao_ref (§3.2.1).

identificador.description: Stable institutional identifier of the system. External reference, not resolved by the NDF.

versao.description: System version at the time the content was produced. The version determines how the result was computed — it is the field that makes this block worth recording.

componente.description: Optional. Component within the system responsible for this production step.

gerado_em.description: Instant at which this step produced its output. Entries are ordered by non-decreasing gerado_em (SPEC.md §2.14.3) — JCS preserves array order, so the order is covered by payload_hash.

regra_ref.description: Optional. Reference to the rule set, rate table or calculation basis applied.

build_ref.description: Optional. Reference to the exact build of the system. Consider omitting in externally circulated documents — see SPEC.md §2.14.5.

configuracao_ref.description: Optional. Reference to the configuration in force. Consider omitting in externally circulated documents — see SPEC.md §2.14.5.

designacao.description: Designation of the body or person legally answerable for the document.

ref.description: Optional. Stable institutional identifier. External reference, not resolved by the NDF.

titulo.description: Title under which legal responsibility is held. Administrative-act regime: competencia_propria, delegacao, subdelegacao. Declarative regime: declaracao_propria, aceitacao_expressa, efeito_legal. See SPEC.md §2.15.2.

publicacao_ref.description: Official publication reference of the enabling act. Required for delegacao and subdelegacao — CPA art. 151.º/1/a) makes the mention of delegation mandatory.

em.description: Instant of the act that established the imputation. Required for aceitacao_expressa. For an authenticated submission, the instant of submission.

autenticacao.description: Optional. Means by which this imputado was authenticated. Recorded per entry, not per document: where the law requires authentication of more than one party (e.g. a joint IRS declaration by both sujeitos passivos), each has its own entry and may authenticate by a different means. See SPEC.md §2.15.4.

meio.description: Authentication means observed by the producing system. Open enum: 'chave_movel_digital', 'cartao_cidadao', 'senha_acesso', 'certificado_qualificado', 'presencial'. In-person identification is deliberately included: a digital-only vocabulary would force the in-person case to be modelled by omission, making it indistinguishable from a document with no identification at all. What legal effect a given means carries is a matter for the applicable regime, not for this vocabulary. See SPEC.md §2.15.4.

nivel_garantia.description: Technical level of assurance of the authentication mechanism, in eIDAS terms. Optional — the producing system may not classify it. It does NOT grade the imputation, because the field does not express gradation: a conforming reader must not derive a weaker imputation, a rebuttable presumption, or any differentiated handling from a lower value. Where an applicable regime attaches consequences to the level of assurance, that assessment is made by whoever applies the regime, on the fact NDF preserved. See SPEC.md §2.15.4.

utilizada.description: Whether an AI system materially influenced this document's creation, transformation, classification, fundamentação or review.

intervencoes.description: Required and non-empty when utilizada is true; must be absent or empty when utilizada is false.

finalidade_detalhe.description: Required when finalidade is 'outro'. Free-text description.

estado.description: 'pendente' makes the absence of review representable and visible, rather than omissible — required even when review has not yet occurred, so the Human-in-the-Loop principle has technical, not only declarative, weight.

revisor_ref.description: Institutional identifier of the human reviewer. Required when estado is a terminal reviewed value.

revisto_em.description: Required when estado is a terminal reviewed value.

evidencia_ref.description: Reference to detailed evidence (full prompts, full responses) kept outside the NDF, under its own access/retention policy. Not required — full prompts/responses must never be mandatory inside the NDF-core.

allOf.title: Unidentifiable origin excludes an identified one
